notes: Removed the banked-plane force-balance method and its selector from Critical Speed Yaw.
Critical Speed Yaw now uses `f_adjusted = f_level + e` as its sole superelevation adjustment.
Direct-radius and chord/middle-ordinate workflows remain available, with percent, degree, and rise/run superelevation input.
Older case files discard the retired method field when loaded and recalculate through the additive path.
Automated validation completed with 820 passing tests.
This release-only artifact must be uploaded to the public release-only repository, not the private source repository.
Do not upload source archives, source trees, CVS/NHTSA downloaded datasets, private keys, or local caches.
